abstract: Suitable tumour markers for monitoring the treatment of seminoma of the testis have not yet been established in clinical practice. Carcino-placental alkaline phosphatase (CPAP) has been suggested for this purpose but it is difficult to detect and specifically analyse this enzyme. We have devised an immunoenzymatic method of analysis in which cross-reactions with liver type and intestinal alkaline phosphatase are minimal and we have applied this test to seven patients with histologically proven seminoma. CPAP was raised in 4 patients prior to treatment and chorionic gonadotrophin in two of these. Alpha-fetoprotein was normal in all cases. We conclude that the use of CPAP in monitoring treatment of testicular seminoma is worthy of further attention.
abstract_ja: 精巣セミノーマの組織学的に確定した7例に、carcino-placental alkaline phosphatase（CPAP）を測定する新たな免疫酵素法を適用した。この方法は肝型および腸型アルカリホスファターゼとの交差反応が最小限である。治療前に4例でCPAPが上昇し、そのうち2例では絨毛性ゴナドトロピンも上昇していた。αフェトプロテインは全例で正常であった。精巣セミノーマの治療モニタリングにおけるCPAPの腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性は、さらに検討する価値があると結論づけられる。
